title: calculations on powertoys run don't give expected value
author: STEo3
summary: PowerToys Run rounds a large integer addition because its calculator engine evaluates numeric expressions with floating-point precision. The same limitation is already tracked by issue 2265.

status.label: Existing precision limitation
status.detail: The reported large-integer rounding matches the calculator-engine precision limitation already tracked in issue 2265.

next_action.label: Link the canonical issue
next_action.reason: Keep the implementation discussion and additional examples on the existing calculator-engine tracker.

judgment.rationale: The exact expression is sufficient to reproduce the known large-number precision loss, and prior equivalent reports were closed in favor of issue 2265.
evidence: The reporter supplied the exact expression `1230954857433123+21313652323312`, expected result 1252268509756435, and actual result 1252268509756440.
Issue 41811 reported the same rounding of a large integer operation and was closed by a PowerToys member as a duplicate of issue 2265.
Issue 2265 remains the open tracker for replacing or improving the PowerToys Run calculator engine.
The current calculator passes expressions through the Mages engine before converting the result to decimal, so the later decimal conversion cannot restore precision already lost during evaluation.
judgment.recommended_action: Close this report as a duplicate of issue 2265 and retain its concrete expression as another reproduction example.

issue_context.summary: A large integer addition in PowerToys Run returns a value rounded by five, matching the existing calculator-engine precision limitation.
known_information: The issue reproduces on PowerToys 0.100.0 Stable on Windows 11 25H2.
The exact expected and actual values are provided.
Prior issue 41811 demonstrated equivalent large-number precision loss and was redirected to issue 2265.
Issue 2265 remains open as the canonical calculator-engine improvement tracker.
inferences: The discrepancy is consistent with precision loss during expression evaluation rather than incorrect addition logic specific to this input.
issue_context.analysis: This report does not need additional diagnostics because the expression is deterministic and matches an established limitation. Consolidating it into issue 2265 avoids splitting discussion of calculator-engine precision.
initial_investigation: Compared the report with issues 41811 and 2265.
Inspected the current PowerToys Run CalculateEngine path, which evaluates through Mages before converting the returned value to decimal.

actions.label: Close as duplicate of calculator precision tracker

comment.body: Thanks for the exact expression and expected value. This is the same large-number precision limitation already tracked in #2265; an equivalent report in #41811 was also consolidated there. Please add any further calculator-engine precision examples or requirements to #2265 so the work stays in one place.
